messages:
rebecca (People Ops): Heads-up: Emma submitted her resignation this morning, last day 2026-04-02. We need to coordinate access deprovisioning, final pay/COBRA, equipment return (EU), license transfers, and a 30-60m exit interview. :wave:
emma.li: Confirmed — last day 2026-04-02. Leaving for a new role, happy to help with KT and overlap. I requested business-only forwarding for 90 days to keep client threads intact — can IT/security enable emma+handoff@ redirection to teamruntime@ for that window?
nick (Eng): Re infra: we should snapshot active jobs and document OWNERS. Emma, can you drop a short KT list and point to any long-lived tokens you created? I'll rotate anything flagged.
rebecca (People Ops): Nick — please post a owners/service-account list by 2026-03-27. IT — open a return ticket and add shipping option for EU address. Emma is remote in Amsterdam.
it-support-bot: Created ticket IT-6821: EU laptop return/shipping. Shipping label option available; carrier pickup can be scheduled 2026-04-03. Estimate 5-7 business days for return to HQ inventory.
payroll-bot: Payroll note: final paycheck processed on last day (2026-04-02). Submit outstanding expenses by 2026-03-29 for inclusion. COBRA notice emailed within 7 business days of termination; enrollment window 60 days from notice.
rebecca (People Ops): Olivia (Security) — forwarding ok? Any constraints or forms to sign? Also need policy on transferring paid licenses (JetBrains) vs seat inventory (Figma).
olivia (Security): Forwarding OK for business emails only. Exclude HR/payroll/benefits folders and any messages flagged as PII. Require signed acknowledgement from Emma for business-only forwarding and explicit end date; SSO disabled after 90 days. Will coordinate with IT to implement.
emma.li: I can sign. I don't need Figma after my last day — release that seat. For JetBrains, I have a personal license reimbursement; will send receipts. I'll add OWNERS entries and a small KT doc in repo: infra/README/offboarding/emma-kts.md
nick (Eng): Repo/service-account summary (quick): infra/kv-cache (owner: emma.li), runtime/kernel-tuning (owner: emma.li), tools/deploy (owner: teamops, emma backstop). Long-lived tokens: deploy-batch-token-2019 -> rotate; incident admin token -> schedule revoke. I'll rotate secrets after confirmation.
rebecca (People Ops): Good. Sam (Recruiting) — please open a backfill req and plan overlap pairing sessions for handoff. Prefer internal referral first.
sam (Recruiting): Opening Staff ML Engineer req today. Will schedule panel and reserve 4 hours for Emma pairing sessions during her final week.
mike (Facilities): EU returns: use https://internal.redwood/it/returns to submit shipping info. If you need pickup, select carrier and available pickup date. Note: restricted items (HSM) require special handling.
olivia (Security): Addendum: For any access to customer PII/data Emma had, create a record of access scope and duration. We'll need to audit before forwarding is enabled.
it-support-bot: Suggested deprovision command (do not run until approved): `./scripts/deprovision --user emma.li --revoke-admin --schedule 2026-04-02 --keep-readonly-until 2026-05-01`
rebecca (People Ops): We'll hold on deprovision until Emma signs acknowledgement and KT is in place. Action list: 1) Nick: full service-account + token rotation plan (due 2026-03-27). 2) IT: schedule EU pickup/ship-back + set forwarding rule (pending Security) (IT-6821). 3) Security: post acknowledgement template + audit of PII access (Olivia) (due EOD). 4) Payroll: final pay + send COBRA notice (Payroll-bot). 5) Recruiting: open req + schedule handoff pairing (Sam). 6) Emma: KT doc, OWNERS entries, receipts for personal license reimbursement. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
emma.li: I'll prepare the KT doc and OWNERS PR by 2026-03-25 and sign the forwarding acknowledgement. Also ok with SSO disable after 90 days.
olivia (Security): I'll post the acknowledgement template here and loop in Legal. It will include: scope of forwarding, excluded folders, retention end date, and signature block.
payroll-bot: COBRA email subject: "Redwood COBRA: Action Required". Reminder: COBRA enrollment 60 days from notice; benefits end on termination date unless COBRA elected.
acknowledgement-bot: Acknowledgement template posted: https://internal.redwood/hr/acknowledgements/emma-forwarding-template (please sign electronically).
rebecca (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Once Nick posts the repos and IT confirms shipping/pickup, I'll publish the offboarding checklist with timeline and close out tasks.
nick (Eng): Posted more detail: rotated `deploy-batch-token-2019` scheduled for 2026-03-28; admin token revoke scheduled 2026-04-02 after signoff. I'll leave read-only DB role until 2026-05-01 as requested.
rebecca (People Ops): Final note — Emma asked for 90 days of business-only forwarding to `teamruntime@redwood.com` with signed acknowledgement. Security approved with conditions. We'll proceed once the signed form is returned. Thanks all.
